package.description: HelpXplain - Simply tell it with pictures

en-US.description: HelpXplain - Simply tell it with pictures
en-US.longDescription:
HelpXplain is the perfect tool to create HTML-based step-by-step instructions.
Create animated step-by-step tutorials and quick instructions in minutes instead of hours. The magic is in the method: it animates a series of simple screenshots, each of which can be edited or replaced at any time.
HelpXplain can also record multi-page screencasts of programs on your computer screen that run in autoplay mode like a video. Recording and editing them is massively easier than trying to create a video!
All Xplains are 100% standards-compliant HTML5 and Javascript, 100% responsive and cross-platform. With an overhead small enough to load in less than a second!
en-US.name: HelpXplain by EC Software

zh-CN.longDescription:
HelpXplain 是制作基于 HTML 的分步指导的完美工具。
只需几分钟而非数小时，即可创建动画式分步教程和快速指引。其秘诀在于独特方法：它能将一系列简易截图动态呈现，每张截图均可随时编辑或替换。
HelpXplain 还能录制电脑屏幕上程序的多页面屏幕演示，这些演示能像视频一样自动播放。录制和编辑过程比制作视频简单得多！
所有 Xplain 作品均 100% 符合 HTML5 和 Javascript 标准，100% 响应式且跨平台。其体积轻巧，加载时间不足一秒！
